slides.title: Celebrations and Festivals
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 7 English, Unit 2: Celebrations and Festivals. In this unit you will explore celebrations and festivals from around the world, with a special focus on traditions that matter to communities across East Africa and beyond. Festivals bring people together. They remind us of our history, our values, and the things that make each culture unique. Whether it is the joy of a national independence day, the colourful lanterns of a harvest celebration, or the excitement of a local sports day, every festival has a story to tell. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Read and understand texts about different festivals and celebrations.
Use prepositions of time (in, on, at) correctly in speech and writing.
Recognise and form compound adjectives (hand-made, brightly coloured).
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to read and understand texts about different festivals and celebrations. You will also use prepositions of time (in, on, at) correctly in speech and writing. You will also recognise and form compound adjectives (hand-made, brightly coloured). Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Language for precise thinking
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: benevolent, charismatic, determined, diligent, enthusiastic, industrious. Listen to each pronunciation in the vocabulary lab, study its meaning in context, and use the word accurately in your own discussion and writing.

slides.title: Read critically
bullets: Festivals That Bring Us Together, part 1
Festivals That Bring Us Together, part 2
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Festivals That Bring Us Together, part 1 and Festivals That Bring Us Together, part 2. Read actively. Identify each text's central ideas, notice viewpoint and reliability, and support every inference with relevant evidence from the text.

slides.title: Prepositions of Time: In, On and At
bullets: Prepositions of time tell your reader exactly when something happens: in holds long stretches of time, on lands on particular days and dates, and at...
slides.narration: The first language focus is Prepositions of Time: In, On and At. Prepositions of time tell your reader exactly when something happens: in holds long stretches of time, on lands on particular days and dates, and at points to precise moments. Notice the structure in the model examples, then apply it deliberately in connected sentences and paragraphs.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Explain, support and improve your ideas
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1: Compare Two Festivals. Organise your ideas, use evidence and respond clearly to questions. In writing, you will plan, draft, check and revise. Use the success criteria before submitting your work.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the vocabulary lab, continue through reading and comprehension, apply the grammar focus, and complete the speaking and writing practices. Use the AI tutor for hints and feedback any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
